supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate extension beyond the outer ocular corners.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-pigmented (greyish) muzzle/chin and the dark-pigmented (black) periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick, everted lower lip with visible structural droop.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable pale depigmented patch or possible scar tissue on the central lower lip/chin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive cranial balding on the crown; visible white hair fringe along the chin line.
